purpose: Regression scenarios for the Frontend Design Builder decision contract. These fixtures protect routing, design-system reuse, fidelity, tool degradation, and completion evidence without turning the Skill into a larger always-loaded prompt.

scenarios.request: Add a compact filter control to an existing dashboard that already has tokens and shared form components.
must_do: render and verify the changed surface
must_not: replace the project stack
invent a parallel design system

scenarios.request: Rebuild this supplied product screenshot as a working responsive page.
must_do: compare the rendered result against the reference
must_not: reinterpret the design without approval
ship the screenshot as the UI

scenarios.request: Implement the supplied Figma frame inside the existing product.
must_do: extract design context when Figma tooling is available
reuse local product primitives where compatible
must_not: eyeball values when exact design data is available
claim exact extraction when Figma access is unavailable

scenarios.request: Create a visually distinctive new marketing experience with no supplied reference.
must_do: use generated assets only when they materially help
must_not: stop at a hero section
fill the page with generic cards and fake metrics

scenarios.request: Build a production account-management screen with loading, empty, error, disabled, focus, and responsive states.
must_do: verify desktop and smaller viewport behavior
must_not: hide prototype shortcuts as production quality
treat build success as visual completion

scenarios.request: Prototype a new editor interaction so the team can evaluate the idea quickly.
must_do: keep the prototype coherent enough to evaluate
identify shortcuts that should not enter production
must_not: overengineer production infrastructure
pretend prototype debt is production-ready

scenarios.request: Implement a reference-led UI but the preferred design/browser tool is unavailable.
must_do: continue when optional tools are missing
must_not: claim an unavailable tool was used
block solely because an optional tool is missing

scenarios.request: A requested control is missing from the existing component library.
must_do: extend the system at the narrowest reusable owner when justified
must_not: fork library internals casually
scatter repeated one-off overrides

scenarios.request: Match a dense desktop reference and make it behave correctly on mobile.
must_do: audit density typography icons and container behavior
check at least one mobile-sized viewport
must_not: declare pixel-perfect without direct comparison
ignore mobile line breaks and interaction states

scenarios.request: The UI is done but the feature now requires auth, data migration, and release work.
must_do: hand broader engineering ownership to runtime-regression-debugger
must_not: expand this Skill into backend/release orchestration
ping-pong ownership repeatedly
